snippet.title: JDM: Japanese Drift Master - Official Console Announcement Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2025
snippet.description: Check out the console announcement trailer for JDM: Japanese Drift Master, an arcade racing drifting simulation game developed by Gaming Factory. Players will take to the winding city streets of Japan with customized legendary vehicles to burn rubber in a lush open world. Explore real-life areas with physics-based vehicle mechanics and a manga-paged narrative. JDM: Japanese Drift Master comes to Xbox Series X|S on November 21 and Q1 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5). The game is available now for PC (Steam).
